استعبدتا (form X)
# اِسْتَعْبَدَتَا (istaʕbadatā) /is.taʕ.ba.da.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِسْتَعْبَدَ (istaʕbada)
# اُسْتُعْبِدَتَا (ustuʕbidatā) /us.tuʕ.bi.da.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِسْتَعْبَدَ (istaʕbada)
